cbv10:0.1: The Safeguard of the Constituent Groups (of Mind & Body)
cbv10:2.1: To all kinds of poisonous snakes it is like the medicine of a divine charm,
cbv10:2.2: it destroyed terrible poisons and all other dangers.
cbv10:2.3: In this order’s domain, (which is) everywhere, always, for all living creatures,
cbv10:2.4: it thoroughly destroys (all dangers), we will recite that safeguard.
